name: necromancer
description: Find the dead in your dependency tree and raise your code on living ones. Night Watch re-checks your projects every night and wakes you when a dependency gets worse.
author: necromancer
highlights: Graveyard page: every watched project and its dead dependencies, with an epitaph and a way out.
Night Watch: a nightly job that notifies only when a dependency's verdict gets worse.
Necromancer agent: writes the Kiro spec and a differential property-based test, then migrates on a local branch. It never pushes.
MCP server: autopsy, diagnose, successors and resurrection_spec for any Kiro agent.
useCases: Keep an eye on the dependencies of the repositories you maintain.
Get a migration branch ready before an unmaintained package becomes an incident.
configuration: Ask the Necromancer agent: "Watch /path/to/project" to add a project to Night Watch.
Night Watch runs daily at 03:00 Asia/Tokyo. Change the time on the Schedule page.

crons.name: night-watch
crons.message: Run Night Watch. Call the nightwatch_run tool once. For every item in its `notifications` list, call send_notification with that item's title and body, priority "default", url "/apps/necromancer" and group_key "necromancer-night-watch". If `notifications` is empty, send nothing and reply with the single word: quiet. Never push, never edit any repository.
